mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies by Reddan Soccer Park and a new moon phase tonight. You can expect an overnight low of 39 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is moving ahead with Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction project. This work includes essential upgrades to water and sewer utilities, along with new curb, gutter, and sidewalk installations to improve local infrastructure.

Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are plenty of ways to play, including trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.

In a notable incident from October 25, local officers conducted a welfare check at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in the arrest of a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Since the store is currently open until 10 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a sweet treat this evening.
